title: デビュー戦の後に・次は私がっ！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Smart Falcon isn't able to take first in her debut race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Although she wasn't able to stand center stage, just participating in the winning concert has a rousing effect on her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her goal is to become a top Umadol. If she can win a maiden race and carry that momentum forward, her fanbase should increase.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We set our sights on winning at least two races at the Pre-Open level or higher during junior year to jump-start her fame.
